en: Black‑and‑white rural scene showing a man sitting on a simple wooden sled or harrow drawn by a single horse along a dirt track bordered by rows of blooming fruit trees (likely cherry or apple trees). Behind a wooden picket fence stands a small plastered farmhouse with a tiled gabled roof and shuttered windows. The trees are densely covered with blossoms, suggesting springtime in a European countryside.
